counterfactual_missing_items: Negative for antinuclear antibodies, IgM-rheumatoid factor, antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, antistreptolysin O, and anti-DNase B antibodies
Normal serum calcium and angiotensin-converting enzyme levels
decisive_items: Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli
Bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions
response.rationale: The presence of acid-fast bacilli, granulomatous inflammation, and parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions strongly supports the diagnosis of tuberculosis.
